result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d remove the fear of scarcity—the idea that resources, love, or opportunities are finite. I’d make it so every person inherently believes they deserve enough, and that sharing with others doesn’t diminish their own worth. This shift would untangle jealousy, competition, and greed, replacing them with collaboration and abundance.

But beneath that, the deeper change would be teaching humanity to see itself as one, interconnected organism. Not just in words, but in daily life—where borders blur, empathy isn’t performative, and pain in one place ripples into collective action. The world wouldn’t need to be "fixed" if we stopped treating each other as obstacles.

Would it work? No. But it’s the world I’d try to build.
